heading: INT. PROBATE COURT - EMPTY CHAMBERS - LATE AFTERNOON

units.text: INT. PROBATE COURT - EMPTY CHAMBERS - LATE AFTERNOON
Dust turns in a shaft of amber light.
A single leather chair stands where the judge once sat.
ATTORNEY RHONDA VASQUEZ-LEE (50s) shuts a thick folder and does not look up.
Across the long oak table, her brother-in-law TEDDY "TEDS" LEE (50s) watches her hands.
He clears his throat.
She ignores it.
Rhonda. Come on.
units.name: TEDDY

units.text: Don't "Rhonda, come on" me, Teds.
units.name: RHONDA

units.text: He leans back.
She finally lifts her eyes.
Hers are dry, but he is the one who looks away.
Dad wanted it split.
units.name: TEDDY

units.text: Dad wanted a lot of things.
units.name: RHONDA

units.text: He stands, paces to the window.
She follows him with her gaze, then rises too, slowly, one hand on the table as if to steady it.
You're really going to contest this.
units.name: TEDDY

units.text: I'm going to read it aloud. Every word. Into the record.
units.name: RHONDA

units.text: He turns.
She holds up the folder, and for a moment the light catches the red wax seal.
You wouldn't.
units.name: TEDDY

units.text: She opens it.
He crosses the room in three strides, but she is already reading.
